queue.title: McDonald's Faces Lawsuit Over Alleged AI-Assisted Price Coordination
queue.resumo: McDonald's (MCD) has been sued in federal court in Chicago in a proposed nationwide class action accusing the fast-food chain of illegally coordinating menu prices across its franchised and company-owned restaurants through an AI-powered pricing system.
